data.title: 宝多六花 · 电车里的唱片纸袋
data.description: 周末返程电车里，六花穿浅色牛仔外套和黑色长裤，把装着二手唱片的纸袋竖在膝上。她用手挡住将要滑落的封套，低头确认后靠回座椅，窗外掠过的光斑照亮一个不经意的笑。
data.action: 扶正纸袋里滑出的唱片封套，安心靠回座位。
data.promptProse: On the return train, Rikka Takarada holds a paper bag of secondhand records upright on her knees and catches a sleeve sliding from the top. Her light denim jacket lies over a dark-green shirt above black trousers. She checks the contents before relaxing into a faint smile. The medium view includes the window and seat back; passing daylight brushes her face and sleeve edges, leaving shifting rectangular patches across the bag.
